name: nullifying-mirror-rest-adds-the-norm-memory-effect-until-end-of-turn
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php. The memory-element override also applied permanently while the Mirror merely sat on the field; it now requires the activated effect (the pol1nz0j1n global effect, expiring at end of turn).

rulesClauses: [REST]: Until end of turn, cards in target opponent's memory are norm element.

engineBug.summary: Nullifying Mirror never rested and its norm-memory effect applied permanently without activation.
